title: Word Frequency Counter
description:
Write a function `word_frequency(text)` that takes a string of text and returns a list of `(word, count)` tuples sorted by frequency (descending), then alphabetically for ties.

Words are case-insensitive and separated by whitespace. Strip punctuation from words (keep only alphanumeric characters and hyphens within words).
hint: Use `re.findall()` to extract words, a dictionary to count, and `sorted()` with a custom key for ordering.
outputExplanation: word_frequency("the cat sat on the mat") counts each word and returns sorted by frequency: [("the", 2), ("cat", 1), ("mat", 1), ("on", 1), ("sat", 1)].

tests.name: Basic text
tests.input: print(word_frequency("the cat sat on the mat"))
